Interface CustomAttachmentSpec<O,C>

Type Parameters:
O - owner type (whatever the consumer's persistence anchors on)
C - content type (what the consumer stores per slot group)
public interface CustomAttachmentSpec<O,C>
Consumer-implemented interface for M7's extension point. Serves two purposes:
  1. Modded owner types. Consumers whose owner type isn't covered by v1's four shipped factories (Ephemeral, Player-attached, Block-scoped, Item-attached) provide their own save / load / dirty hooks via this spec and use StorageAttachment.custom(spec) to wrap it.
  2. Decorator-path escape hatch. Consumers decorating vanilla menus via ScreenPanelAdapter — which doesn't route through MKCScreenHandler and therefore doesn't get the default handler-owned save/load lifecycle — use a custom spec and trigger save/load from their decorator mixin directly.

The library never learns what O is. The spec handles all owner-specific persistence; the library only dispatches lifecycle calls.

Content type C is the consumer's choice. For the common case (NonNullList<ItemStack>), the consumer implements a straightforward spec; for structured content (records, wrappers), the consumer provides conversions inside the spec methods.

  • Method Details

    • read

      C read(O owner)
      Read the stored content for this owner instance. The returned content becomes the authoritative state for subsequent Storage reads. If nothing has been persisted yet, return a default built from defaultFactory().

    • write

      void write(O owner, C content)
      Write the content for this owner instance. Called after consumer mutations (via Storage.setStack) to flush to persistent storage.

      For Fabric-attachment-backed specs, implementations typically call owner.setAttached(attachmentType, content) here.

    • markDirty

      void markDirty(O owner)
      Mark the owner as needing persistence. For block entities, call be.setChanged(). For entities / players, this is often a no-op (Fabric auto-persists attachment changes on save).

    • defaultFactory

      C defaultFactory()
      Produces a fresh default content when no stored value exists yet. For an NonNullList<ItemStack>-based spec with slotCount slots: 
        () -> NonNullList.withSize(slotCount, ItemStack.EMPTY)

    • toItemList

      net.minecraft.core.NonNullList<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack> toItemList(C content)
      Converts stored content to a mutable NonNullList view for the Storage surface. If C is already NonNullList<ItemStack>, return the content directly (identity). For structured content, convert.

    • fromItemList

      C fromItemList(net.minecraft.core.NonNullList<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack> items)
      Converts a mutated item list back to the structured content, preserving any non-ItemStack fields. Called by the Storage surface after each setStack so the mutation persists through write(O, C). If C is already NonNullList<ItemStack>, return the list directly (identity).

    • slotCount

      int slotCount()
      How many slots this content holds. Used by the Storage surface to report size.

    • id

      net.minecraft.resources.Identifier id()
      Identifier for this spec — useful for debug logging and for distinguishing specs that share an owner type.
